text.tspan: Risk of lower volume of placement and online disintermediation (for perm), intense competition/lack of pricing power limit margin optionality
Revenue exposure via data centre construction. AI optimisation of network density and connected fleet should support margin expansion over the midterm.
Limited impact on both revenue and margin, AI less relevant to the investment case.
Limited impact on both revenue and margin, AI less relevant to the investment case.
Limited impact on both revenue and margin, AI less relevant to the investment case.
Opportunity with leading positioning in data center commissioning. Potential for efficiency gains meaningful combined with pricing power.
Accelerating revenue exposure in the US business, notably in WCW and some in Seals.
Limited revenue exposure but pricing power combined with AI optimisation of route density could support margin expansion over the midterm.
Relatively limited revenue exposure but AI could support efficiency gains in a market where we think Eurofins has pricing power given its leading position.
Relatively limited revenue exposure but AI could support efficiency gains in a market where we think Experian has pricing power given its leading position.
Revenue exposure through data centre construction work. AI optimisation of network and route density should support margin expansion.
Risk of lower volume of placement and online disintermediation (for perm), intense competition/lack of pricing power limit margin optionality
Limited impact on both revenue and margin, AI less relevant to the investment case.
Neutral impact. Lower employment could be compensated by more outsourcing/concentration, some AI use cases but pricing power relatively limited.
Risk of lower volume of placement and online disintermediation (for perm), intense competition/lack of pricing power limit margin optionality
Risk of lower volume of placement and online disintermediation (for perm), intense competition/lack of pricing power limit margin optionality
Limited revenue exposure but pricing power combined with AI optimisation of route density could support margin expansion over the midterm.
Limited impact on both revenue and margin, AI less relevant to the investment case.
No obvious direct revenue exposure to AI. Potential for AI-enabled secruity systems to reduce costs but we consider pricing power to be limited.
Most revenue exposure from cybersecurity and AI certification services. Combination of AI efficiency gains and pricing similar to other testers.
Enabler of AI with data center exposure and energy business. Pricing power, no obvious scalable AI use cases and positive mix: slight positive for margins.
Risk of revenue headwind with small contribution from AI data services for now, extensive potential AI use cases but debate on ability to improve margins
Limited impact on both revenue and margin, AI less relevant to the investment case.
No risk to revenue given competitive moat, AI to support continued divergence between ARPU (growing) and RMC (declining) and therefore margins.
